content.title: 22 Evangelical Seminaries To Consider in 2026
content.text: As pastors, the call to lead and serve never slows down, and sometimes, continuing education through evangelical seminaries can feel out of reach. But when we don’t prioritize growth, the cracks begin to show:These struggles often come because we lack access to fresh, practical insights and mentorship that further education can provide.That’s why I’ve compiled this list of top evangelical seminaries—so you can explore options for deepening your knowledge, enriching your ministry, and staying spiritually vibrant. Here’s a closer look at some of the best seminaries and what makes each one unique. Best Evangelical Seminaries Shortlist Here’s my shortlist of the best evangelical seminaries I think are worth your time in 2026 TheosU Reformed Theological Seminary The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary Dallas Theological Seminary Westminster Theological Seminary Trinity Evangelical Divinity School Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary Bethel Seminary Princeton Theological Seminary Asbury Theological Seminary Denver Seminary Tyndale Seminary (Tyndale University) The Master's Seminary Talbot School of Theology (Biola University) Northern Seminary Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary Covenant Theological Seminary Luther Rice College & Seminary Wheaton College Graduate School Beeson Divinity School (Samford University) Fuller Theological Seminary Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary Find more about each seminary below. Overview Of The Best Evangelical Seminaries 1. TheosU The TheosU seminary (Source) TheosU offers courses that explore theological, philosophical, and historical concepts from both traditional and modern perspectives, focusing on Christ and teachings relevant to Evangelical Theological Seminary students. They address cultural issues, doctrinal debates, and historical analysis, providing insights from various theological traditions. Who It’s For Those interested in accessible, online theological education Topics Covered: Biblical Theology Christian Doctrine Church History Apologetics Cultural Engagement Eschatology New Testament Studies Old Testament Studies Online, In-Person, or Both? Online Exam Required? No Duration: Self-paced How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by course Eligibility Requirements: None Price: Core Annual: $159.99 per year ($13.99 per month) Clubhouse Annual: $440 per yr ( $37 per month) Take The Course: TheosU 2. Reformed Theological Seminary The Reformed Theological Seminary (Source) Reformed Theological Seminary offers many graduate-level theological courses focusing on Reformed theology, with discussions that often engage with Catholic perspectives and the nature of God. Courses are structured for in-depth academic study, emphasizing biblical scholarship and preparation for ministry. Who It’s For: Individuals seeking a rigorous, Reformed theological education with a strong emphasis on biblical fidelity, pastoral training, and academic scholarship Topics Covered: Systematic theology Old and New Testament studies Church history Pastoral care Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Semester-based program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Price: Varies by program Take The Course: Reformed Theological Seminary 3. The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary Southern Baptist Theological Seminary (Source) Southern Baptist Theological Seminary offers courses in core areas like theology, biblical studies, church history, and Christian ethics. These programs emphasize doctrinal development, pastoral training, and ethical understanding within a solid theological framework. Who It’s For: Individuals seeking theological education, future Christian leaders and missionaries. Topics Covered: Biblical Studies Theological Studies Church History Ministry and Leadership Biblical Counseling Missions and Evangelism Worship Leadership Christian Education Apologetics Ethics Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Varies by program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Take The Course: Southern Baptist Theological Seminary 4. Dallas Theological Seminary The Dallas Theological Seminary (Source) Dallas Theological Seminary offers courses centered on a dispensationalist interpretation of the Bible, providing in-depth training in biblical exegesis and theology. These courses are designed to equip students with a strong theological foundation for ministry. Who It’s For: Those pursuing pastoral ministry, missions, Christian leadership, biblical counseling, and academic teaching roles Topics Covered: Bible exposition Systematic theology Biblical Counseling Pastoral Ministries Christian leadership Apologetics and evangelism Educational Ministries Intercultural Ministries Media Arts and Worship Chaplaincy Doctoral programs Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Varies by program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Take The Course: Dallas Theological Seminary Get tips and tools to make church admin quicker. So you can get more time for what matters most. 5. Westminster Theological Seminary The Westminster Theological Seminary (Source) Westminster Theological Seminary offers courses centered on the rigorous study of Reformed theology and Scripture, with a strong emphasis on in-depth engagement with biblical texts and theological reflection. The curriculum combines historical, exegetical, and doctrinal approaches to provide a comprehensive theological education. Who It’s For: Aspiring pastors, church leaders, and missionaries, as well as seminary students and theologians pursuing academic or scholarly work Topics Covered: Biblical Studies Systematic Theology Church History Apologetics Practical Theology Hermeneutics Historical Theology Pastoral Counseling Missiology Christian Ethics Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Semester-based program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Price: Residential Programs: Free Online Programs: $675 per credit hours Advanced Degree Programs: Varies from $4,800 per course to $9,540 per course Take The Course: Westminster Theological Seminary 6. Trinity Evangelical Divinity School The Trinity Evangelical Divinity School (Source) Trinity Evangelical Divinity School offers courses that provide comprehensive theological and biblical education with a strong emphasis on scriptural exegesis, ministry practice, and theological research. The programs combine academic study with practical training for leadership and service in diverse ministry contexts. Who It’s For: Aspiring pastors, theologians, educators, counselors, and lay leaders and individuals seeking evangelical training for roles in pastoral ministry, academia, missions, counseling, and Christian leadership Topics Covered: Divinity Theological Studies Intercultural Studies Mental Health Counseling Ministry Educational Ministries Chaplaincy and Ministry Care Bioethics Theology Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Varies by program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Price: Varies from $770 per credit hour to $950 per credit hour with a $175 audit fee per credit hour Take The Course: Trinity Evangelical Divinity School 7. Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary The Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary (Source) Southeastern Baptist Theological Seminary offers courses that combine biblical studies, theology, and leadership development, focusing on practical ministry skills. The evangelical seminary programs integrate spiritual formation with hands-on training for diverse ministry contexts. Who It’s For: Individuals preparing for ministry or mission work Topics Covered: Divinity Church Planting Counseling Christian Education Ethics, Theology, and Culture Intercultural Studies Worship Ministry Theological Studies Ministry Education Philosophy Online, In-Person, or Both? The evangelical seminary programs integrate spiritual formation with hands-on training for diverse ministry contexts. The programs integrate theological reflection with leadership preparation for various ministry and academic settings. Asbury Theological Seminary The Asbury Theological Seminary (Source) Asbury Theological Seminary offers evangelical seminary programs that integrate theological education with practical ministry training, focusing on spiritual growth and leadership skills. The courses are designed to equip individuals for roles in ministry, missions, and other vocational fields. Who It’s For: Individuals interested in Wesleyan theology and ministry Topics Covered: Divinity Ministry Theological Studies Transformational Leadership Marriage and Family Therapy Mental Health Counseling Christian Thought Ministry Online, In-Person, or Both? Denver Seminary The Denver Seminary (Source) Denver Seminary offers courses emphasizing deep biblical exegesis, systematic theology, and leadership development, all integrated with practical ministry training. The curriculum combines rigorous academic study with real-world ministry experience, preparing individuals for roles in pastoral leadership, chaplaincy, counseling, and missions within diverse church and community settings. Who It’s For: Individuals preparing for leadership roles in ministry Topics Covered: Divinity Leadership Biblical and Theological Studies Counseling Chaplaincy Pastoral Care Apologetics and Ethics Justice and Mission New Testament Old Testament Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Varies by program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Price: Master’s Program: $680 per credit hour Doctor of Ministry:$710 per credit hour Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Counselor Education and Supervision:$960 per credit hour Audit non-credit courses: $185 per credit hour Take The Course: Denver Seminary 12. Tyndale Seminary (Tyndale University) The Tyndale Seminary (Source) Tyndale Seminary, part of a Christian university and accredited by the Association of Theological Schools, offers courses that focus on biblical studies, theology, pastoral ministry, and Christian education. The curriculum, shaped within the university school context, integrates academic scholarship with practical ministry training, emphasizing a holistic approach to spiritual formation and leadership development. Who It’s For: Students seeking ministry or counseling roles Topics Covered: Biblical Studies Theology Christian History Pastoral Ministries Spiritual Formation Christian Education Global Mission Christian Leadership Counselling Youth and Family Ministry Worship and Liturgy Church Planting and Development Urban Ministry Apologetics Intercultural Ministries Online, In-Person, or Both? Both Exam Required? Yes Duration: Varies by program How Many Hours Of Instruction: Varies by program Eligibility Requirements: Bachelor’s degree Take The Course: Tyndale Seminary 13. The curriculum emphasizes accurate Scripture interpretation and prepares individuals for ministry throughout America, providing a solid foundation in biblical doctrine and church leadership. Who It’s For: For individuals seeking rigorous theological education and pastoral training to prepare for leadership roles in church ministry Topics Covered: Biblical Studies Theology Old Testament Studies New Testament Studies Church History Pastoral Ministries Biblical Counseling Apologetics Hermeneutics Homiletics Greek Hebrew Ecclesiology Missiology Online, In-Person, or Both? These courses emphasize deep theological understanding and spiritual formation grounded in biblical principles. Who It’s For: Individuals pursuing advanced theological education and ministry training, including pastors, missionaries, educators, counselors, and Christian leaders seeking to deepen their biblical knowledge and leadership skills Topics Covered: Bible Exposition Christian Ministry and Leadership Old Testament New Testament Theology Philosophy Spiritual Formation Christian Apologetics Biblical and Theological Studies Educational Studies Marriage and Family Therapy Online, In-Person, or Both? The seminary emphasizes integrating learning with real-world ministry contexts. Who It’s For: Individuals who are pursuing careers in ministry, counseling, leadership, and spiritual development Topics Covered: Biblical Studies Theology with an Emphasis on Women and Ministry Theology with an Emphasis on Black Church Studies Christian Ministries Theological Studies Theology and Mission New Testament Old Testament Christian Community Development Urban Leadership Worship Worship – Korean Divinity Online, In-Person, or Both? The curriculum emphasizes scriptural interpretation, church history, and pastoral leadership, preparing individuals for roles in ministry and service. Who It’s For: Individuals pursuing careers in pastoral ministry, missions, church leadership, biblical scholarship, and counseling Topics Covered: Biblical Counseling Christian Education Divinity Theological Studies Missions Worship Leadership Philosophy Apologetics Archaeology Online, In-Person, or Both? With a strong emphasis on preparing leaders for service, the programs are designed to equip learners for faithful ministry in various contexts, and enrollment is open to those seeking comprehensive theological education. Who It’s For: Individuals pursuing leadership roles within Reformed or Presbyterian contexts Topics Covered: Divinity Theological Studies Counseling Educational Ministries Ministry Missional Theology Worship and Arts Biblical and Theological Studies Christian and Cultural Leadership Online, In-Person, or Both? The courses are designed to prepare students for service in the church or various Christian ministries, emphasizing a strong biblical foundation. Wheaton College Graduate School The Wheaton College Graduate School (Source) Wheaton College Graduate School offers doctoral and master’s programs that deliver high-quality training in both theory and practice from a distinctly Christian perspective. The programs emphasize integrating academic excellence with service to prepare individuals for leadership in various fields. Who It’s For: Individuals seeking advanced education rooted in a Christian perspective, including hose pursuing careers in ministry, counseling, education, leadership, missions, and biblical studies. Topics Covered: Biblical and Theological Studies Clinical Mental Health Counseling Teaching Higher Education and Student Development Evangelism and Leadership Missional Church Movements Marriage and Family Therapy Ministry Leadership Theology History of Christianity Intercultural Studies Outdoor and Adventure Leadership Christian Formation and Ministry Humanitarian and Disaster Leadership TESOL and Intercultural Studies Global Leadership Online, In-Person, or Both? The programs are grounded in the historic Christian faith and designed to equip learners for faithful service in the church. The courses blend academic rigor with practical ministry training, rooted in evangelical Christian theology, while also engaging with Lutheran and broader Protestant traditions.
